summary: Practise retail portfolio analysis, scorecard review, and IFRS 9 impairment exercises. Explore the five-day course and syllabus.
lede: Retail credit risk management helps lending and risk professionals assess consumer exposures and follow portfolio performance. Participants practise segmenting portfolios, interpreting PD, LGD and EAD, reviewing scorecards, and using roll rates to identify delinquency movement. They also develop monitoring dashboards and an IFRS 9 loss analysis, while learning operational oversight considerations for automated and AI-assisted credit decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess consumer lending decisions, monitor retail portfolios, estimate credit losses, or report credit risk to business leaders.
modules: AI and Model Governance in Lending
Credit Risk Reporting and Action Planning
prerequisites: Prior familiarity with retail lending, credit assessment, credit operations, or portfolio reporting is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted scoring and model governance are introduced at operational awareness level.
